description.value: The Chemainus Theatre Festival is a fully professional, non-profit theatre in the seaside community of Chemainus on Vancouver Island, presenting Canadian performers in a 274-seat wheelchair-accessible auditorium with a raked floor for clear sightlines from every seat. Founded in the early 1990s as part of Chemainus's celebrated arts renaissance, the theatre pairs live productions with an on-site Playbill Dining Room serving meals for up to 160 guests. It serves as a cultural anchor for the community and a compelling stop for visitors exploring Vancouver Island.

Café or food on site.detail: On-site Playbill Dining Room seats up to 160 guests and serves continental breakfasts, nutrition breaks, lunches, and dinners; dining can be added to theatre ticket bookings

wow_evidence: Professional festival theatre (274 seats) that anchors mural-town tourism — provincially known destination venue; show-conditional.
